allowed_options.semantics: Affirm that none of the 16 enumerated named stated descendants of C12950 in NCIt 26.07d is a better filler for C2860/R103 than C12950.
Retain the source-supported C2860/R103/C12950 assertion while qualifying or withdrawing the global most-specific claim.
Select one of the 16 enumerated existing NCIt candidates as a proposed replacement and initiate a separately governed correction proposal.

prior_decision_rationale: C12950 is supported by C2860’s stated derivation from adrenal embryonic rest cells. It is anatomically broad but is the most specific currently available NCIt tissue-origin filler; no range-compatible, more specific NCIt replacement has been identified.
question: For C2860/R103/C12950, does one of the 16 enumerated named stated descendants of C12950 in NCIt 26.07d provide a better normal-tissue-origin filler than C12950?
